description.value: Ruckle Park's group campsite on Salt Spring Island sits in a grassy meadow overlooking Swanson Channel with rich wildlife and shoreline; access requires a BC Ferries crossing from Swartz Bay, group fees apply to a minimum of 15 adults, and potable water is off November through mid-March.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record links to the Ruckle Park BC Parks page, which confirms this is a tent-only group campsite within a provincial park on Salt Spring Island. OSM tags (drinking_water=yes, shower=no, toilets=yes, power_supply=no, caravans=no, tents=yes) are consistent with the website's description of park facilities, including a specific note about seasonal water shutdown from November 1 to March 15. The BC Parks group camping reservation page confirms reservations are accepted via camping.bcparks.ca or by phone.
concerns: OSM name is the generic 'Group Campsite' with no reference to the parent park (Ruckle Park) — may be difficult for cyclists to identify independently.
No street address recorded in OSM.
Group campsite minimum charge structure (minimum 15 adults for regular bookings) makes this unsuitable for solo or small-group cycle tourists.
Potable water is seasonal — shut off November 1 to March 15.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Ruckle Park is a well-known provincial park on Salt Spring Island, a popular Gulf Islands cycling destination; the group campsite provides tenting with potable water and toilets and is a valid WWC listing for cycling groups and clubs touring the island.
enrichment_extras.notes: This is the group campsite within Ruckle Park on Salt Spring Island, BC. The parent park page is bcparks.ca/ruckle-park/. Group reservations are made through camping.bcparks.ca.

wow_evidence: Ruckle Park's group campsite on Salt Spring Island sits in a grassy meadow overlooking Swanson Channel... a popular Gulf Islands cycling destination
